text:
samira: Customer (AcmeCo) rotated their API key and is getting 401 "invalid_api_key" when their app sends a composite value in the header (id:secret). They said curl with only the secret succeeds. Repro steps attached.

mike: Which endpoint and header exactly? hosted or dedicated? can you paste the failing curl?

samira: It's hosted (api.redwood.example). Failing curl they sent:
```
curl -H "x-api-key: abc123DEF:ghI789klm" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"}
They also tried Authorization header with the same composite value and got 401 as well.

jess: ask them to try just the secret (after the colon) as a quick test

samira: they tried that and it worked:
```
curl -H "x-api-key: ghI789klm" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hello"}'
# -> 200 OK
```
So the id:secret composite is being rejected.

leo: reproduced locally. If the header contains a colon we reject with 401. Our auth parser used to accept legacy id:secret formats for audit logging but a recent hardening removed that. Server log shows:
```
auth: parse error: unexpected ':' in API key value
auth: user-agent=AcmeBot request_id=... status=401
```

mike: can we confirm intended behavior? for hosted we probably should accept only secret and require separate id header. Escalate to eng-auth if this is a breaking change.

samira: customer needs immediate workaround (zero-downtime). I advised them to strip the id client-side and redeploy; that works. They asked for a better error message so they know why it failed.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-12345 created and assigned to eng-auth (priority P2).

jess: added repro steps to ticket: failing curl, working curl, server log snippet, and a short node snippet showing how some clients build "id:secret" automatically. @eng-auth please triage.

leo: short-term: we'll update rotation docs and dashboard UX to call this out. long-term: eng-auth can either reintroduce legacy parsing behind a flag or provide a migration header.

samira: will reply to customer with the workaround and link to the ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:

mike: closing thread; monitoring ticket for eng response.
